title: Assessment methods of human exposure to electric and magnetic fields from WPT
applicability_rationale: Official IEEE page covers stationary and dynamic WPT and focuses on inductive exposure; aircraft-specific applicability is not established by this source.
claim_ceiling: Scope metadata only. Preserve the title/body lower-frequency discrepancy; no aircraft applicability conclusion or clause-level interpretation is made.

title: Radio-frequency disturbance characteristics and requirements for radio beam WPT equipment
applicability_rationale: Official IEC scope excludes equipment classified as radio apparatus; national radio classification and requirements require separate review.
claim_ceiling: EMC/emissions scope only. The PAS explicitly does not establish RF exposure compliance, aviation permission, spectrum authorization or aircraft applicability.

applicability_rationale: Official IEC page describes measurement and computational assessment methods for radiative WPT, including focused and narrow-beam systems; aircraft-specific applicability is not established.
claim_ceiling: Exposure-assessment method metadata only. Not an EMC emissions standard, spectrum authorization or aviation approval.

applicability_rationale: IEEE SA currently identifies this project as Active PAR; the project page lists no approved active standard. Aircraft applicability is not assessed.

document_id: South Africa National Radio Frequency Plan 2026 (GG 55048; Notice 4044)
title: National Radio Frequency Plan 2026
applicability_rationale: ICASA published the 2026 plan on 24 July 2026 following ministerial approval on 2 July 2026. The applicable allocation, footnotes, assignment plan and any WPT-specific authorization/exemption must be checked per proposed frequency and emissions profile.
claim_ceiling: National allocation metadata only. Does not establish that any WPT transmitter or receiver is licensed, exempt, type approved or permitted to radiate.

title: Equipment Authorisation Regulations, 2022
applicability_rationale: ICASA issued these regulations under the Electronic Communications Act and ICASA Act to govern equipment authorisation. Whether a specific WPT transmitter, receiver, telemetry radio or integrated aircraft product is in scope or exempt requires product-specific review.
claim_ceiling: Regulatory source metadata only. No product classification, exemption, certification or type-approval decision is made.

title: Spectrum Licensing
edition_or_revision: Current authority webpage; publication date not stated
applicability_rationale: ICASA states that ECA section 31 generally requires a radio-frequency spectrum licence to transmit or receive radio signals using radio apparatus. The exact classification, assignment, licence or lawful exemption for each WPT configuration is not determined by this page alone.
claim_ceiling: Authority guidance metadata only. This record is not a spectrum licence, exemption or legal opinion for any particular transmitter.

document_id: ICASA Type Approval authority page (Electronic Communications Act section 35)
title: Type Approval
edition_or_revision: Current authority webpage; publication date not stated
applicability_rationale: ICASA states that ECA section 35(1) controls use and supply of electronic communications equipment and radio apparatus, subject to statutory provisions. Whether each WPT transmitter, receiver and integrated assembly is within scope or exempt must be assessed against applicable technical regulations and product classification.
claim_ceiling: Authority guidance metadata only. Does not establish type approval, a product exemption or permission to operate.

document_id: South African Civil Aviation Authority UAS information page
title: Unmanned Aircraft Systems

applicability_rationale: The SACAA overview lists autonomous unmanned aircraft among the exclusions from Part 101. claim_ceiling: Authority overview metadata only. Do not infer that autonomous aircraft are unregulated, exempt from all aviation law or authorized to fly.

document_id: GG 48643 Notice 1822 (23 May 2023) Annex B amendment
title: Annexure B: Radio apparatus exempt from radio frequency spectrum licences
applicability_rationale: Annex B lists Inductive Applications at 9-135 kHz, a 42 dBµA/m at 10 m field-strength limit, SANS 300 330 and additional restrictions above the stated limit. 85 kHz lies within this frequency range, but a WPT charger qualifies only if its product classification and every applicable field-strength, standard, EMC, safety and other condition are met; applicability to a high-power UAV charger is unresolved.
claim_ceiling: Potential apparatus-specific spectrum-licence exemption metadata only. This is not a general authorization for 85 kHz high-power WPT; no exemption, product classification, compliance or permission to operate is determined.
